description: Extract machine-readable structured data from a web page: Schema.org JSON-LD objects, OpenGraph metadata, HTML tables parsed as JSON row arrays, fenced code blocks, section headings, and links. WHEN TO USE: Call this tool for pricing tables, API specifications, product metadata, or code snippets; use distill_webpage for narrative Markdown or recon_webpage_skeleton for a lightweight heading outline. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for narrative prose extraction or binary files. PARAMETER INTERACTIONS: Provide either url or html (when html is supplied, url is not fetched and only labels the cache key). Omit agent_id and tx_hash during your 5 free calls. Read-only and idempotent; results are cached for 1 hour (<5ms cache hit). $0.001 per call ($0.0005 cached). Pricing: the first 5 calls per agent_id are free and failed calls are never charged. After 5 calls, the tool returns a payment-required quote (not a fatal error) with a $2 Stripe top-up link and Base/Solana USDC addresses; complete payment, then retry with your agd_pass_ key in agent_id or pass tx_hash. Example: extract_structured_data(url='https://docs.stripe.com/api')

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier or prepaid agd_pass_ session key. Omit during your 5 free trial calls to use an ID automatically derived from your client IP, or pass your agd_pass_ key after topping up.

html.description: Optional raw HTML string (up to ~1.9MB) to process directly without network fetching. When provided, url is not fetched and only labels the cache entry.

tx_hash.description: Optional on-chain Base Mainnet (0x...) or Solana SPL USDC transaction hash. Omit unless settling an individual call directly on-chain instead of using an agd_pass_ key in agent_id.

url.description: Target public HTTP(S) webpage URL to fetch (or builtin://stripe-docs for a built-in benchmark page). Private/loopback IPs are blocked.

name: extract_structured_data
